"A game where you start as a mammal similar to a rat or mouse and have to climb the evolutionary tree. During your evolution the things you eat dictate what the diet of your species is. Every action you take gets you evo points, and when the timer runs out, you evolve based on your evo points. The more time you spend aairborne the closer you get to being avian. The more time you spend climbing the closer you get to being a tree dweller, etc. If you attack a lot of things you get closer to a predator, and if you eat vegetation, blah blah blah. Basically, i want you to make it so you can evolve your own species, and if you neglect doing certain things, you lose evo points forthat stat, get it? And i want it in the style of a choose your own adventure game.  Every scene should have pictures and a minimum of 6 choices. And evo optionals are cosmetic. Basically, you get to choose what raises breeding appeal every time you EVO UP. And there should be things you can do to gain special evo points, where you can allocate points to anything you want. Those situations should come in the form of a dream, and you get a choice in the dream, and your choices decide which evo line you get points i to, and those choices are derived from your 6 highest evo slots. When you select one, it raises that evo stat by 10, and it won't tell you what stat is being raised, or even that it raises a stat. Those dream sequences should have no apparent benefit, but they get factored in at the time of evolution. You should get 10 of them per sequence.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable choose-your-own-adventure evolution game in the existing workspace.

## Requirements
- Start as a mouse-like mammal; actions shape six evolutionary stats, diet, and species.
- Every scene has an illustration and at least six choices.
- Stats grow with related actions and decay when neglected; evolution occurs after a timed sequence.
- Each evolution offers a cosmetic breeding-appeal choice.
- Each season is followed by 10 dreams; choices are based on the six highest stats and secretly add 10 points to the chosen stat.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game in `index.html` with inline CSS/JS and SVG forest illustrations.
- Assumed an eight-action season, six stats (Aerial, Arboreal, Predatory, Foraging, Aquatic, Burrowing), browser localStorage saves, and dream bonuses applied at evolution.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented intro, action scenes, six-choice dream scenes, evolutionary outcomes, dietary tracking, stat decay, cosmetic appeal, and local saves.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and a smoke test covering actions, 10 dreams, evolution, and the next season.
- Generated `/tmp/opencode/screenshots/game.png` with Chromium.

### Active
- Visual verification: convert the generated PNG to a small JPEG and inspect it.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` browser launch failed because its expected Chromium installation was missing; direct `/usr/bin/chromium` screenshot succeeded.
- JPEG conversion was not completed; Python Pillow and common image converters are unavailable.

## Next Move
1. Convert `/tmp/opencode/screenshots/game.png` to a JPEG using any available browser or image conversion method, then inspect the latest screenshot.
2. Check `index.html` in the browser for layout/rendering issues and fix if needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire playable game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is an untracked file.
- Smoke test printed: `Gameplay smoke test passed: Cloverkin generation 2 next season actions 8`.
- A local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; direct screenshot command used `chromium --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --screenshot=/tmp/opencode/screenshots/game.png --window-size=1280,900 http://localhost:3002`.
